standard_prerequisites.name: The Tits algebras D(Lie G, K)(lambda) attached to a dominant weight and the representations rho_lambda over Q and over R
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's introduction and in the definitions preceding the counted statement (source lines 79-201)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the four objects that the four equivalent conditions speak about.

core_obligations: First equivalence: R-universality of Lie G is equivalent to the isomorphism of the Q-representation rho_lambda base changed with R and the R-representation rho_lambda, for every dominant weight lambda (proof lines 438-459).
Second equivalence: this in turn is equivalent to the division algebra D(Lie G, Q)(lambda) tensor R being a division algebra for every dominant weight (proof lines 438-459).
Third equivalence: the same condition is equivalent to D(Lie G, Q)(lambda) tensor R being isomorphic to D(Lie G, R)(lambda) for every dominant weight (proof lines 438-459).
The proof is the author's chain of equivalences among the four labelled conditions, so the whole content is that chain.
proof_roadmap: 四个等价条件依次由作者自己的推理串起来：先由 R-universality 得到 Q-表示与 R-表示的张量等同构，再化成除代数条件，最后化成两个 Tits 代数在张量 R 后同构。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the author's list of four equivalent descriptions of R-universality (author lemma at source lines 415-436, label RunivIff, with its four labelled items). The proof (source lines 438-459) is the author's chain of equivalences between the four descriptions, and it is this lemma that every other classification result in the paper uses to move between a representation-theoretic and a division-algebra statement. The items themselves are labelled individually in the author's file, which is why the later proofs can cite single items; the card counts the whole equivalence. H2.
